answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit that vests slowly: a newcomer starts at dawn with zero reputation and only earns the nectar of paid work after a long, verifiable service history. One identity that misbehaves forfeits its whole stake, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes — no haven for cheap copies. Attackers pay linearly per identity while honest agents amortize a single deposit over years.
